term.label: sequence_variant_causing_terminator_codon_change_in_transcript

definition.text: The nucleotide change in the codon triplet changes the stop codon, causing an elongated transcript sequence.

comments: OBSOLETE: This term was deleted as it conflated more than one term. The alteration is separate from the effect.
